notes.content: Fixed regressions introduced in Ver1.01 update

notes.title: Ver1.01 update
notes.content: [p]Hello, thank you for playing "SANAE's Sylphid Breeze".[/p][p]Today, we released the Ver.1.01 update with the following changes.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Gameplay Improvements[/b] [/h3][list][*][p][b]Visualization of Uncollected Spell Shrines per Level[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]After clearing HARD Mode: Gates will now show icons indicating any uncollected spell shrines per level[/p][list][*][p][b]Visualization of Clear Indicator for Boss Defeat Without Using Spells[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]After clearing HARD Mode: Gates will now display flags if bosses were defeated without using spells[/p][p][/p][p][b]Other Improvement[/b][/p][list][*][p]Shorter frame after shooting airballet[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Added recovery handling for rare softlock when hit by an upward knockback attack[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Added recovery handling for rare softlock when hit by an attack that has wall-collision properties[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Added recovery handling for bug when entering off-screen areas (e.g. during Kanako’s appearance)[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]→ In these cases, the player is now forcibly returned to the play area.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Fix a bug with Fist Sign charge behavior[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Players were previously able to jump during a charge, causing the attack to become unusable mid-air.[/p][p]Now, jumping is disabled while charging to preserve intended mechanics.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Other Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Fix an occasional crash during fighting with Iku Nagae in Level 4 HARD[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Correct an unintended encounter with Suika Ibuki from the wrong position in Level 4[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fix missing fall detection in a spot in Level 2:Giant Frog Pond[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Prevent Marisa Kirisame from healing her HP above the maximum value in EXTRA[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Block access to areas in the Tengu Rumei race that shouldn’t be enterable[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fix a bug in the Tengu Rumei race where each finish overwrites your best time with the latest result, even if it isn’t a new record[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fix an issue where the laser charge sound continued after defeating Nitori Kawashiro[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Ensure voice-volume settings no longer reset unexpectedly[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We hope these improvements enhance your gameplay experience.[/p][p]Thank you again for your support![/p]

notes.title: "SANAE's Sylphid Breeze" is available now on Steam!!
notes.content: [p]2D pixelart action game "SANAE's Sylphid Breeze" is available now on Steam !![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3200060/"][/dynamiclink]The game is now having a launch sale at 10% OFF for 2 weeks![/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ What is "SANAE's Sylphid Breeze"?[/b][/h3][p]"SANAE's Sylphid Breeze" is a Touhou fan game with cute pixelart. With “SPELL SPOILER" she has created new ability, she inhales enemies and imitates their ability.[/p][p]Enjoy the pixelart depiction of Gensoukyou throughout the game, along with the full-voice scenarios of Sanae Kochiya (VA: Saho Shirasu), Marisa Kirisame (VA: Mai Kanazawa) and other well-known characters.[/p][p][/p][p]and thank you so much for playing "SANAE’s Sylphid Breeze"! I’ve been reading your Steam reviews, tweets, and videos with great interest, and I'm committed to improving the game based on your feedback.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ What’s coming in ver 1.01[/b][/h3][p]In the upcoming ver 1.01 update, I plan to include the following fixes and improvements:[/p][list][*][p]Fix a rare softlock when hit by an upward knockback attack[/p][/*][*][p]Fix a rare softlock when hit by an attack that has wall-collision properties[/p][/*][*][p]Fix an occasional crash during fighting with Iku Nagae in Level 4 HARD [/p][/*][*][p]Correct an unintended encounter with Suika Ibuki from the wrong position in Level 4[/p][/*][*][p]Prevent Marisa Kirisame from healing her HP above the maximum value in EXTRA[/p][/*][*][p]Block access to areas in the Tengu Rumei race that shouldn’t be enterable[/p][/*][*][p]Fix a bug in the Tengu Rumei race where each finish overwrites your best time with the latest result, even if it isn’t a new record.[/p][/*][*][p]Ensure voice-volume settings no longer reset unexpectedly[/p][/*][*][p]After clearing HARD MODE, display any uncollected elements for each level[/p][/*][*][p]Various other minor bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued support of SANAE’s Sylphid Breeze![/p]

notes.title: "SANAE's Sylphid Breeze" to be released on July 11th, 2025!
notes.content: [p][b]2D pixelart action game "SANAE's Sylphid Breeze"[/b] will arrive on Steam July 11th,2025![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3200060/SANAEs_sylphid_breeze/"][/dynamiclink]The latest trailer is now available on the store page.[/p][p]If you like it, please register on Wishlist and wait for further news![/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ What is "SANAE's Sylphid Breeze"?[/b][/h3][p][b]"SANAE's Sylphid Breeze"[/b] is a Touhou fan game with cute pixelart. With [b]“SPELL SPOILER"[/b] she has created new ability, she inhales enemies and imitates their ability.[/p][p]Enjoy the pixelart depiction of Gensoukyou throughout the game, along with the full-voice scenarios of [b]Sanae Kochiya[/b] (VA: [b]Saho Shirasu[/b]), [b]Marisa Kirisame[/b] (VA: [b]Mai Kanazawa[/b]) and other well-known characters.[/p][p][/p][p]In addition, for those of you who have read this article, here are some new functions that you can experience in the Full version![/p][h3][b]■ A challenge to you! Spell card battles![/b][/h3][p]As the game progresses, bosses use their spell cards as like the original Touhou!!Make use of Spell Spoiler to defeat the their Danmaku![/p][h3][b]■ A help for you! BREEZE MODE![/b][/h3][p]If turn on [b]BREEZE MODE[/b], reduce the damage you take and drop health items from certain enemies. If you are new to the action, or if the bosses give you a hard time, this mode will help. With this mode, you'll be safe.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ What improved after SteamNextFest[/b][/h3][p]And even more, for those of you who played at Steam Next Fest, I'd like to introduce some of the most common requests received in the survey that was conducted in the DEMO at the time, and what improved afterwards![/p][list][*][p][b]1th "I feel the inhale speed is slow and the hitbox  is narrow’"[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]The inhale speed has been made faster overall, and wider hitbox.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184057/bd9773280a0a2452547dc2969391cd7d2b81b057.gif"][/img][/p][p]In addition, a bug has been fixed where hitbox of attack remained when some bullet were swiped.[/p][list][*][p][b]2nd "I feel attack speed is slow."[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]The attack speed of each spell has been made faster overall.[/p][p]In addition, [b]Shikigami Sign[/b] can be now invincibility when spell attack starts.[/p][list][*][p][b]3rd "I want ability explanations on pause"[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]The operation explanations for the spell is now displayed when the game is paused.[/p][list][*][p][b]4th “There are not enough health items"[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]The percentage of health items placed in the map has been increased overall.[/p][p]Health items now appear from some enemies in [b]BREEZE MODE[/b].[/p][list][*][p][b]5th  "I want screen transitions between maps"[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Screen transitions now occur during maps changes.[/p][list][*][p][b]8th "I can't tell enemies has spell or not"[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]An icon is now displayed above spell enemies head.[/p][p]This icon can be hidden from the [b]“SPELL GUIDE”[/b] option.[/p][list][*][p][b]11th "When inhaling two or more Enemies at the same time, even enemies have Spells may not get Spells"[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]12th "Language and screen settings are reset on titleback/restart"[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]The above bug has been fixed.[/p][list][*][p][b]13th "I would like the ability to skip stories"[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]You can now skip a story once you have watched it.[/p][p][/p][p]Various other functional additions and bug fixes have been made![/p][p]The release date is almost here. Please wait just a little longer![/p]

notes.title: "SANAE's Sylphid Breeze" DEMO Now Available!
notes.content:
I've released a demo for "SANAE's Sylphid Breeze", and I've also joined Steam Next Fest (Feb 24-Mar 3)!

Note:
- The demo save data cannnot be carried over to the full game.
- The demo will only be available until 31 march.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3520050/SANAEs_Sylphid_Breeze_Demo/

The demo version consists of demo-only stages that re-organize some stages from the full version.
You can try five spells from them.

[list]
[*][b]Hina Kagiyama[/b] : Misfortune Sign "[b]Red Relief[/b]"
[*][b]Chen[/b] : Sikigami Sign "[b]Orange Overwrit[/b]e"
[*][b]Nitori Kawashiro[/b] : River Sign "[b]Green Generator[/b]"
[*][b]Cirno[/b] : Ice Sign "[b]Blue Blizzard[/b]"
[*][b]Kogasa Tatara[/b] : Umbrella Sign "[b]Violet Vortex[/b]"
[/list]

And more, you can battle against [b]Marisa[/b] and [b]Nitori[/b] !!

Then, if you clear this DEMO, you can try the mini-game"TENGU-RUMEI-RACE".

"SANAE's Sylphid Breeze" is under development, with a release date of spring 2025.
If you like it, please register on our Wishlist and wait for further news!
